transform.colorPolicy: Untagged pixels interpreted as sRGB; no measured color-space assertion

exportDetails.losslessScope: Exact transformed pixels, all channels verified

checks.detail: Untagged source explicitly interpreted as sRGB
Deterministic pixels prepared without undeclared enlargement

inspection.reviewer: Assistant after viewing original, unchanged previously inspected approved style input, decoded export, light/dark/checkerboard panels, both usage sizes and all eight current container colors; independent equipment/contact/readability observation by second assistant reviewer

checks.name: identity
checks.observation: Viewed original and decoded runtime: one adult walking on one unbranded inclined treadmill, side three-quarter view facing left. The complete figure and machine are visible.

checks.name: style-consistency
checks.observation: Compared with the actual approved front-plank master: blue-gray top, muted terracotta leggings, hair bun, natural proportions and soft educational shading remain consistent. Neutral gray shoes and machine use the restrained palette with no visible branding.

checks.name: walking-and-contact-readability
checks.observation: Upright trunk and walking arm swing read as walking rather than a running flight phase. Front shoe visibly meets the belt and rear heel is raised with the toe near/on the belt plane; hands are clear of the rails rather than supporting the body. No obvious duplicated limb or disconnected joint observed. Independent second reviewer agreed the walking/contact interpretation.

checks.name: equipment-plausibility
checks.observation: The belt visibly rises toward the front console on the left. Console, paired rails, posts, belt deck and base frame read as continuous equipment. No obvious disconnected rail, extra machine or conflicting frame component observed. This is visual plausibility, not engineering or gait validation.

checks.name: alpha-and-decoded-edges
checks.observation: Viewed source/export light and dark composites, export checkerboard and all eight current container colors. Surrounding and frame-opening areas are transparent, with no visible rectangular backdrop, colored fringe or distracting matte halo.

checks.name: usage-framing
checks.observation: Viewed actual source/export 256x144 and 320x180 panels and all eight current 320x180 container composites. Full bun, hands, shoes, console and machine feet stay within contain bounds; incline and walking silhouette remain readable. Vertical margins are tight, approximately 2dp at the top and 4dp at the machine feet in the 180dp frame, but no clipping observed. Shoe contact detail is clearer at full export size.

checks.name: interface-remnants
checks.observation: No visible text, console numbers, incline values, labels, arrows, app controls, phone frame, scenery, logo or watermark observed.

limitations: Vertical margins are tight (approximately 2-4dp at 180dp height) but the subject and machine are not visibly clipped.
Illustration observations do not clinically validate gait or mechanically validate the treadmill; no exact incline percentage is asserted.
Untagged source pixels are explicitly interpreted as sRGB under the profile, without claiming measured embedded sRGB or a color conversion.

Usage boards are deterministic illustration composites using current presentation.json container colors, not actual RN/native component renders, text/control contrast measurements or signed-phone acceptance.
Human artwork and activation approval remain pending; no production promotion performed.
